meta.title: Vietnam in 7 Days 🇻🇳 The Perfect Itinerary: Hanoi, Ha Long Bay, Ninh Binh & Da Nang
meta.description:
Hello everyone, welcome back to GADT Travel! 👋

Planning to visit Vietnam for just 7 days? 🇻🇳 You can still experience some of the country's most incredible destinations with the right itinerary.

In this video, we're taking you through a 7-day Vietnam itinerary covering the highlights of Northern and Central Vietnam — from the historic streets of Hanoi and the spectacular limestone landscapes of Ninh Binh to a relaxing cruise in Ha Long Bay and the beautiful beaches and cultural heritage of Central Vietnam.

🗺️ OUR 7-DAY VIETNAM ITINERARY

Day 1 – Hanoi 🇻🇳
Explore Vietnam's capital and discover its fascinating history, vibrant Old Quarter, local food, and unique culture.

Day 2 – Ha Long Bay Cruise 🛳️
Enjoy a day cruise through the spectacular limestone islands and emerald waters of Ha Long Bay.

Day 3 – Ninh Binh 🌿
Discover the breathtaking landscapes of Ninh Binh and experience one of Vietnam's most beautiful natural destinations.

Day 4 – Da Nang 🌊
Travel to Da Nang and enjoy the city's beautiful coastline and vibrant atmosphere.

Day 5 – Ba Na Hills & Golden Bridge ☁️
Visit Ba Na Hills and the famous Golden Bridge, one of the most iconic attractions in Central Vietnam.

Day 6 – Hoi An 🏮
Explore the charming ancient town of Hoi An, discover its historic streets, local cuisine, and beautiful atmosphere.

Day 7 – Hoi An & Departure ✈️
Enjoy some final time in Hoi An before ending your Vietnam adventure.

This itinerary is a great option for first-time visitors who want to experience Vietnam's history, nature, culture, food, and iconic attractions in a short amount of time.

✨ Planning your own Vietnam trip?

At GADT Travel, we can customize your Vietnam itinerary based on your travel dates, interests, budget, hotel preference, and schedule. You can combine destinations, add or remove activities, or adjust the pace of your trip to create an itinerary that works for you.
